title: Public C backup KEK mapping input, pending D persistence alignment
description: Non-authorizing input to the original reference:kek admission. No field proves approval. Identity/version must already exist in the original registry; no derivation from provider names or probe hashes.
x-runtime-validation: config_ref must equal the original current/proposed reference:kek pin for this installation/config. config_sha256 and source_revision are observation bindings, not immutable key identity: another config may reference the identical immutable mapping.
key_binding.identity_hash and registry_version equal config_ref.identity_hash and version byte for byte.

Both operation refs must be authenticated by the original registry. Their provider_identity_hash and scope_hash equal the provider descriptor. Do not assume distinct operation refs have the same identity/version; require the original registry relation to the same logical KEK.
provider_key_id, endpoint, key_name and provider numeric version are resolved from authenticated original mapping, never inferred from names, versions or probe SHA.

Current permission, validity interval, revocation and mapping retention are supplied by the original trusted authority and rechecked in its transaction. Generate/write permission, current independent retained unwrap permission and preservation deadlines are separate facts; loss of write permission must not erase historical mapping or imply unwrap permission.

ca_source is an immutable record in the authenticated original source, never an arbitrary path/URL to open. Its retrieved PEM bytes must match ca_pem_sha256. Preserve mapping and CA while referenced, without preserving an old execution grant as authority.
A scalar snapshot/source_revision is not evidence of complete retained scanning or shared locking. Missing source or recheck rejects admission.
